# Rosalind Penrose

## Overview

- **Age:** Forty-five years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v2 c21 P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>; Miss Penrose  <sub>[v2 c21 P32](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0032), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosalind is a small woman with lovely, thick, wavy snow-white hair styled in flattering puffs and coils. Beneath her hair, she has an almost youthful face with rosy cheeks, sweet lips, dimples, and large, gentle brown eyes flecked with gold. She wears delicate attire, such as cream muslin patterned with light roses.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c22 P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Rosalind is gentle, hospitable, and deeply imaginative, maintaining a youthful spirit despite her age. She delights in the company of young people and loves beauty, flowers, and romantic sentiment. Though somewhat secluded and considered eccentric by some, she possesses a warm and tender heart.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003)_

## Traits

- Imaginative  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c27 P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059)</sub>
- Hospitable  <sub>[v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P58](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0058)</sub>
- Fond of youth  <sub>[v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>

## Abilities

- Imaginative roleplay and story-telling  <sub>[v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c27 P63](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0063)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep her youthful spirit through imaginative play and pleasant company  <sub>[v2 c21 P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)</sub>

## History

Rosalind Penrose grew up as the daughter of old Mr. Penrose, who built an ancient stone house in an isolated area near West Welby. In her youth, she was considered a notable beauty and became engaged to Stephen Stanhope twenty-five years ago. Following a disagreement, their engagement ended, and Stephen left for the United States. Rosalind withdrew to her quiet stone residence, living largely secluded from social life. Years later, Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke stopped by her home while seeking directions, discovering her pretending to host a tea party with her handmaiden, Belinda the Fourth. Rosalind welcomed them warmly into her home, sharing her imaginative disposition with Nell. Later, Nell brought Stephen's young son, Cedric Stanhope, to visit Echo Cottage, where Rosalind bonded with Cedric over their shared love of imaginary companions and dream-people.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c21 P47](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0047), [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084), [v2 c22 P3](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0003), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), [v2 c27 P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059), [v2 c27 P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062), [v2 c27 P66](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0066)_

## Background by volume

- Named Rosalind by her father because he loved the fragrance of lavender associated with meeting her mother  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Was engaged to Stephen Stanhope twenty-five years ago before a disagreement separated them  <sub>[v2 c21 P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009)</sub>
- Resides in an ancient sandstone house known as Echo Cottage near West Welby  <sub>[v2 c21 P47](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0047), [v2 c27 P66](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0066)</sub>

## Quotes

> Belinda the Fourth mentioned that you wanted to speak with me  <sub>[v2 c21 P46](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0046)</sub>
